newsitem.title: USA: Dow opens higher, Nasdaq sees modest rebound.
newsitem.headline: Dow opens higher, Nasdaq sees modest rebound.

text.p: U.S. blue chips opened higher on Wednesday, running to yet another high of 7581 before scaling back to a 21-point rise at 7560. Technology stocks rebounded from a weak close, gaining about four points to 1406.
Analysts said the market is seeing more foreign investor involvement, which is boosting the Dow components, while the rest of the market is mixed.
The long bond was up 4/32 at a 6.83 percent yield. The Standard & Poor's futures index was off 0.10 to 868.60.
